Amber = radiologist (dashed on the model panels for reference) · slate = MedGemma 27B · blue = Skanda.
IoU = best box overlap with the radiologist; score = Skanda's abnormality score (0–1, gate-calibrated).
Abnormal case: Skanda's best box overlap in the set; normal case: random (seed 0) among normals Skanda cleared.
